snippet.title: Boing Fight – Official Trailer | Party Brawler for 1–4 Players – Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
Boing Fight is out now on Steam – −40% until November 26: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5363430/Boing_Fight/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer_v2

A bouncy physics party brawler for 1–4 players – on one couch or online, with bots for empty seats. Grab a weapon, mind the traps and be the last Boing standing.

⚔️ 18 weapons – from a sword and a hammer to a bazooka and saw blades
💥 30 kinds of traps and 150 arenas – castles, pirate ships, dungeons and more
🎮 7 game modes, teams and an arena editor with Steam Workshop
🎨 14 art styles to unlock – Halloween, Christmas, magic, pirates, Wild West, 8-bit, comic book and more

Music: “Who Likes to Party” Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

#BoingFight #PartyGame #IndieGame
